central_result: Ligand-only 3D geometric learning did not outperform ECFP4 models under ALOX15 five-fold scaffold-disjoint validation.
interpretation: The predictive value of three-dimensional geometry was endpoint-dependent rather than universally superior.
candidate_scope: Literature-reported metabolites from other Lilium species; not chemically confirmed in Lilium mackliniae.
prohibited_claims: Do not claim that the 3D EGNN outperformed ECFP4.
Do not describe screened compounds as confirmed Lilium mackliniae metabolites.
Do not describe predictions as experimental therapeutic activity.
